sentences: I check the wall calendar each morning to see what day it is and what appointments I have.
I flip the page of my desk calendar at the start of each month to reveal the new month's dates.
I write appointments on my digital calendar and set reminders so I do not forget them.
I use a weekly planner calendar to organize my tasks and appointments for each day of the week.
I mark holidays on my calendar with a red pen so I can see them at a glance.
I count the days remaining in the month on my calendar to track how much time is left.
I sync my phone calendar with my computer calendar so both devices show the same events.
I note the phases of the moon on my lunar calendar to keep track of the lunar cycle.
I record birthdays on my calendar so I remember to send cards or make phone calls.
I check the fiscal calendar to see when the quarter ends and when reports are due.
I use a countdown calendar to track the number of days until a deadline or event.
I look at the year-at-a-glance calendar to plan vacations and major events for the year.
I add a leap day to my calendar every four years to keep it aligned with the solar year.
I set the first day of the week to Monday on my calendar app to match my work schedule.
I print a monthly calendar and hang it on the refrigerator so the family can see it.
I color-code events on my calendar by category, such as work, personal, and family.
I schedule recurring meetings on my calendar so they appear automatically every week or month.
I cross off each day on my calendar as it passes to keep track of the current date.
I share my calendar with my family members so we can coordinate our schedules together.
I set the time zone in my calendar app when I travel to a different region for work.
